headline: Japan's First?
caption:
Chihiro Sawada is one win from becoming the first Japanese woman to hold a ONE world title.
Sawada or Nikolakakos? 👇

Sawada (12-1) meets unbeaten Anastasia Nikolakakos (7-0) for the vacant ONE women's atomweight MMA title at ONE Samurai 6 on Dec. 2 at Yokohama Buntai. ONE Championship title fight news.

Who takes the belt?
question: Sawada or Nikolakakos?

v2.story: A Sawada win makes her the first Japanese woman to hold a ONE world title.
